phases.label: Architecture registry & doctrine
phases.purpose: Canonical machine registry, external-system matrix, SoT policy, and validators so future packets have a governed map. No product feature work.
phases.dependencyRule: No later phase should contradict registry JSON or matrix defaults without an explicit governance revision packet.
phases.governanceGate: Steve / coordination protocol for any change to sos-public boundary or cross-lane import rules.

phases.label: Email Command Center — hosted and live proof
phases.purpose: Prove Kelly-Grappe-App DB chain, governed live send posture, automation dry-run safety, production ingestion proof, and final operational verification.
phases.dependencyRule: HOSTED-DB-PROOF before LIVE-SEND-PROOF and PRODUCTION-CONTACT-INGESTION-PROOF on hosted targets.
phases.governanceGate: Operator-run gates; EMAIL_WORKFLOW_CAN_SEND_FROM_ITEM and no-send scan posture unchanged unless an explicit execution packet changes them.

candidateSlices.goal: Operator-verified hosted DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL migrate + import gate + diagnose on Kelly-Grappe-App.
expectedOutputs: Hosted verification log doc or ledger update

candidateSlices.goal: Operator-proven governed test/broadcast on hosted stack per send-execution doctrine.
Safe dry-run of automation worker paths with no outbound side effects.
Prove staged import commit path on hosted DB with real governance checks.
forbiddenPaths: PII in fixtures committed to repo
proofRequired: Import batch smoke without secrets in logs
expectedOutputs: Ledger deployment row bump if earned

candidateSlices.goal: Cross-surface ECC verification pass after proofs (Daily, Message Studio, SendGrid, Analytics, queue).
mustNotDo: Introduce new send paths without scan

phases.label: Campaign memory foundation
phases.purpose: Schema inventory, grounded memory index, entity linkers, retrieval API, and memory governance gates.
phases.dependencyRule: MEMORY-SCHEMA-INVENTORY before SOURCE-GROUNDED-MEMORY-INDEX and RETRIEVAL-API; governance gates before production retrieval exposure.
phases.governanceGate: No unsourced claims; RAG/ingest licensing explicit per slice.

candidateSlices.goal: Inventory Prisma + SearchChunk + related models for memory surfaces.
Define grounded index contracts (chunks, provenance, staleness) aligned with existing ECC grounding.
proofRequired: Doc review with counsel flag for legal-sensitive
mustNotDo: Auto-ingest copyrighted bulk without license packet

candidateSlices.goal: Deterministic linker design between contacts, counties, and events (read models first).
proofRequired: Unit or integration tests if code added
mustNotDo: Mutate voter PII in smoke data

candidateSlices.goal: Bounded internal retrieval API for operator/admin use with rate and scope limits.
mustNotDo: Expose voter file to anonymous users
expectedOutputs: API route or server action set

candidateSlices.goal: Explicit gates for index freshness, approval tiers, and redaction.
mustNotDo: Bypass human approval for sensitive memory writes

phases.label: Daily operational intelligence
phases.purpose: Briefing schema, open loops, readiness snapshot engine, executive briefing surfaces, operator action queue.
phases.dependencyRule: READINESS-SNAPSHOT-ENGINE should consume existing getEmailCommandCenterSnapshot contracts; DAILY-BRIEFING-SCHEMA before EXECUTIVE-BRIEFING-DASHBOARD.
phases.governanceGate: Advisory-only AI; no auto task or send mutations from briefing surfaces unless explicit future packet.

candidateSlices.goal: Define JSON/schema for morning briefing sections and sources.
Detect stalled queue items, pending approvals, and missing assignments from read models.
Normalize readiness snapshot computation for reuse by Daily and Analytics.
Executive-facing rollup UI (read-only) using briefing schema + snapshots.
Prioritized operator queue fed by open loops + readiness (human triage first).

phases.label: Scheduling intelligence
phases.purpose: Calendar source audit, availability engine, county tour intelligence, follow-up reminder queue, scheduling governance.
phases.dependencyRule: CALENDAR-SOURCE-AUDIT before AVAILABILITY-SUGGESTION-ENGINE; governance gates before auto reminders to externals.
phases.governanceGate: Tentative vs approved calendar transitions; no unsolicited bulk outreach.

candidateSlices.goal: Audit calendar data sources, sync jobs, and webhook boundaries.
mustNotDo: Disable OAuth scopes without replacement plan

candidateSlices.goal: Suggest holds and slots from calendars + field constraints (advisory).
forbiddenPaths: Auto-write Google Calendar without consent packet

candidateSlices.goal: County clustering and tour route hints for schedulers (read-heavy).
forbiddenPaths: Auto-publish tour dates to public site

candidateSlices.goal: Internal reminder queue for staff (not voter spam); integrates with Daily.
forbiddenPaths: External SMS/email send without send packet

candidateSlices.goal: Policy for tentative holds, approvals, and conflict surfacing.
proofRequired: npm run check if enforced in code

phases.label: Governed AI orchestration
phases.purpose: Prompt registry, grounding contract, recommendation explainer, approval workflow, action audit log.
phases.governanceGate: Human approval for any AI-suggested mutation; explainability mandatory.

candidateSlices.goal: Central registry of prompts/roles/versioning aligned with brain registry patterns.
Formal contract for evidence buckets and unsupported claims handling across AI surfaces.
Structured explanations for every AI recommendation path (why, confidence, sources).
Wire human approval steps for AI-proposed mutations (tasks, drafts, audience).
Append-only audit metadata for AI-triggered actions and operator overrides.

phases.label: Self-build queue system
phases.purpose: Slice schema, forbidden-path gates, dependency graph, queue generator, progress ledger sync, handoff packet generator.
phases.dependencyRule: SELFBUILD-SLICE-SCHEMA and FORBIDDEN-PATH-GATES before QUEUE-GENERATOR and HANDOFF-PACKET-GENERATOR.
phases.governanceGate: AUTO_BUILD_PROTOCOL hard stops; no migrations or sends from generator without human packet.

candidateSlices.goal: JSON schema for slice packets (mission, paths, checks, rollback).
Enforce forbidden path lists in CI or pre-commit for slice PRs.
forbiddenPaths: Disabling gates in same PR as risky code

candidateSlices.goal: Machine-readable dependency edges between packets and migrations.
mustNotDo: Declare false dependencies to skip gates

candidateSlices.goal: Generate ordered queue suggestions from graph + ledger blockers.
proofRequired: npm run check if TS tool

candidateSlices.goal: Sync self-build outputs with campaign-email-command-center-progress-ledger and PROJECT_MASTER_MAP rules.
Emit handoff markdown/json for next agent from completed slice.

phases.label: Consolidation — review only
phases.purpose: Decision records when merging or deduplicating docs; no runtime merges of sibling apps.
phases.dependencyRule: Requires CONSOLIDATION_REVIEW_POLICY and external matrix as inputs.
phases.governanceGate: Steve approval for any cross-lane doc consolidation that implies integration.

candidateSlices.goal: Append-only records of which doc is canonical when two sources conflict.

phases.label: Public site interface contract
phases.purpose: Formal contract for how RedDirt informs sos-public without coupling (exports, review, publish).
phases.dependencyRule: Runs after boundary doctrine stable in registry matrix; no code in sos-public from RedDirt lane.
phases.governanceGate: Explicit integration packet if any shared package or API bridge is ever proposed.

candidateSlices.goal: Document allowed handoff formats (copy deck JSON, media manifest) and forbidden imports.
mustNotDo: Add RedDirt dependency to sos-public in this slice
